lines.text: Thanks for making time, Rosa. We're excited to show you what Brightpath can do for Northgate.
We need SSO on day one. Our security policy is non-negotiable on this.
SAML single sign-on will be live within two weeks of signing, that's standard for us.
We'll also need our job history migrated. It's in CSVs right now.
We can handle the CSV migration within thirty days of signature.
We'll have the job history export ready for you by the first of next month.
What's the go-live timeline if we sign by end of March?
Sign by March 31st and we target go-live by May 15th, standard forty-five day track.
We'd also want a dedicated open item tracker for ongoing commitments.
We'll set that up as part of onboarding, that's on us.
Good. Anything else we need to align on today?
I think we've covered the key items. I'll send over the formal proposal this afternoon.
